articles.title: Make rent receipts for HRA
articles.summary: Make 12 monthly rent receipts at once in Nivesh Sahayak: landlord, PAN, tenant, rent per month, months, date on each receipt, mode, three per A4 page.

articles.title: How rent receipt numbers work
articles.summary: How rent receipt numbers work in Nivesh Sahayak: RR series per business, restart every 1 April, change the prefix, and fix a duplicate number.

articles.title: Print, PDF and share a rent receipt
articles.summary: Print a rent receipt on A4, A5 or a thermal roll, pick one of 7 designs and copies, save a PDF, or share it on WhatsApp from Nivesh Sahayak.

articles.title: Saved rent receipts: find, open, copy and edit
articles.card: Saved rent receipts: open, copy, edit
articles.summary: Find any saved rent receipt in Nivesh Sahayak: search the Saved rent receipts list, open to edit or reprint, copy it as new, set its status.
